title: Wright Brothers
subtitle: Wright Flyer I
summary: Orville and Wilbur Wright completed the first successful powered, heavier-than-air controlled flight near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
details: Constructed from spruce wood and unbleached muslin, powered by an aluminum-block 12 hp engine built by Charles Taylor.

title: Spirit of St. Louis
subtitle: Ryan NYP Monoplane
summary: Charles Lindbergh made the historic first solo nonstop transatlantic flight from Roosevelt Field, New York to Le Bourget Field in Paris.
details: Fuel tanks were installed in front of the cockpit to maintain balance as fuel burned, requiring a periscope to see directly ahead.

title: Bell X-1
subtitle: Experimental Rocket Plane
summary: Captain Charles 'Chuck' Yeager broke the sound barrier for the first time in level flight over Rogers Dry Lake in California.
details: Nicknamed 'Glamorous Glennis', the aircraft fuselage was inspired by the shape of a .50-caliber browning bullet known to be aerodynamically stable.

title: Space Shuttle
subtitle: NASA Orbiter Fleet
summary: NASA launched the first Space Transportation System flight (STS-1), pioneering the first reusable orbital winged spacecraft.
details: Equipped with over 24,000 ceramic thermal tiles designed to withstand 1,260°C (2,300°F) re-entry heat as it glided back to a runway landing.
